cells.gaps: ONIP's legal expert described the general population file in August 2024 as the single reference fed by civil-status events and used for all secure titles (COD-002 to COD-004), but that is the file's role in law: in May 2024 ONIP was still entrusted with building it (COD-005), and in 2024 and 2025 Kintambo and Kinshasa were only beginning to digitise their registers (COD-006, COD-001). No source says the file is in service.
cells.note: Stage 2 because the general population file is being built: ONIP's mandate to build it (2024), the Kintambo pilot (2024) and Kinshasa's digitisation launched in November 2025. Stage 3 needs the register in service, and the legal expert's account states what the file is for, not that it runs.
